description: Whether the workspace can open its billing code as a pull request: if that is switched on, whether the Last Price GitHub App is set up on this deployment, and which GitHub account the workspace installed it on. A person installs the App from the Monetization page, Automated tab. Early access. Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_github_app_connection
